body.statement: Under \(\mathsf R_{\mathrm{DGS},n}(P_n)\), Dhawan, Guo and Shah's Corollary 2 gives asymptotic power one for the hunted-direction score test along sequences for which, with probability tending to one conditionally on the training sample, \(\operatorname{Corr}_{P_n}(s_{P_n}(U),\xi_{P_n}(U)\mid\widehat h_n)>\kappa_n\), and for which \(n\kappa_n^2V_{\mathrm{DGS}}(P_n)\to\infty\).

source.verbatim_statement: Consider the setup of Theorem 1 and suppose sequences (ε_n) and (ρ_n) are such that inf_{P∈P(ε_n)} P_P(Corr_P(s_P(X), ξ_P | ĥ) > ρ_n) → 1 and n ρ_n² ε_n → ∞, where P(ε) := {P∈P : τ_P ≥ ε}. Then for any α∈(0,1), inf_{P∈P(ε_n)} P_P(T_n > z_{1−α}) → 1.

attestation.note: Verified directly from the author-posted arXiv HTML v1 for arXiv:2607.28861, Section 4.2, Corollary 2, display (17) and its following power conclusion. The run node renames ρ_n to κ_n and instantiates ε_n as V_DGS(P_n) under its DGSRegularity handle.
